d:
In Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, police have arrested Salman, who is accused of holding a young woman captive in a hotel and assaulting her. On November 25, when the police attempted to corner him, he allegedly opened fire on the police team. He subsequently sustained injuries while trying to escape. In a video that surfaced following his arrest, Salman is seen crying and pleading for forgiveness. He says, "Sir, I made a mistake. It won't happen again. Please forgive me."
